instruction: Set all new Writer document indexes to use Georgia as their default font.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring LibreOffice Writer's default font for indexes (table of contents, keyword indexes) to Georgia. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu file for the Index property in the DefaultFont configuration section. Georgia is a serif font well-suited for indexes and reference materials.
